name: Cable Concentration Curl
steps: Sit near the end of a bench facing a low pulley and brace your working upper arm against your inner thigh with your palm up.
Bend your elbow and bring the handle toward your shoulder.
Lower the handle until your elbow is nearly straight.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep the back of your working upper arm pressed steadily against your inner thigh.
Avoid leaning back or pulling with your shoulder to finish the curl.
